meta.title: Operation of Heating Mantle in Pharmacognosy Laboratory

sections.purpose: To provide uniform, flameless heating to round-bottom flasks during Soxhlet extraction, reflux, and distillation operations involving organic solvents in the Pharmacognosy laboratory.
sections.scope: Applicable to Pharmacognosy laboratory for heating round-bottom flasks during solvent extraction, reflux extraction of crude drugs, and distillation of essential oils where direct flame is prohibited.
procedure: Select a heating mantle of the correct volume that matches the round-bottom flask to be used — the flask must sit flush inside the mantle bowl.
Inspect the mantle for damaged or exposed heating wires, burnt fabric, or cracked bowl — replace if damaged.
Place the heating mantle on a stable, heat-resistant surface or mount it on a ring stand at an appropriate height.
Fill the round-bottom flask with the material to be heated (maximum 2/3 full) and add boiling chips if required.
Seat the flask in the heating mantle bowl — the flask base must make full contact with the mantle fabric.
Connect the heating mantle to a variable voltage controller (variac) — never connect directly to mains voltage without a voltage controller.
Connect the variac to the mains power.
Set the variac to the minimum setting; switch on and gradually increase the voltage to achieve the desired heating rate.
Monitor the temperature using a thermometer or thermocouple inserted into the flask via an appropriate adapter.
For reflux: ensure the condenser is connected and coolant is flowing before applying heat.
Maintain the required temperature throughout the extraction/distillation period.
At the end of the process: reduce the variac to zero, switch off, and disconnect from mains.
Raise the flask out of the mantle using a lab jack or ring stand adjustment — do not leave the flask sitting in the hot mantle.
Allow the mantle to cool completely before handling.
Store in a clean, dry place — do not coil the power cord tightly around the hot mantle.
precautions: Never connect the heating mantle directly to 220 V mains without a voltage controller — instant burnout of the heating element.
Never heat a dry empty mantle — immediately destroys the heating fabric.
The exterior of the mantle becomes very hot — never touch during operation; use tongs to handle.
Ensure the flask fits the mantle correctly — a flask too small will tip and spill; too large overhangs and heats unevenly.
Do not use with flammable solvents in an open flask without a condenser and in a fume hood.
Inspect the mantle fabric before each use — broken wires generate sparks; replace the mantle if wires are exposed.
Lower the flask into the mantle gently — impact can crack the flask.
Do not allow solvent spills onto the mantle — spills cause immediate fire risk and destroy the heating element.
